children: Strategy, the world's largest corporate holder of Bitcoin, said it has a $35 billion net reserve and that none of its Bitcoin holdings are pledged as collateral.
Wu Blockchain reported on November 20 that Strategy's net reserve stands at $35 billion and that all of the Bitcoin it holds is unencumbered.

That is a sharp contrast with the company's financial position during the 2022 crypto bear market. Strategy said its net reserve was negative at the time, and about one-third of its total Bitcoin holdings had been pledged as collateral.

The company said its financial resilience has improved since it weathered the 2022 market downturn. It also emphasized that none of its current Bitcoin holdings are pledged, giving it more flexibility in financial management than in the past.
Strategy said it survived that bear market and returned stronger. Its conviction in Bitcoin and scope for strategic choices have never been stronger, it said.

Still, the company did not disclose a detailed methodology or breakdown for its $35 billion net reserve in the statement. As a result, the figure is difficult to interpret as equivalent to cash or immediately available liquidity.

title: Strategy Says None of Its Bitcoin Holdings Are Pledged, Net Reserve at $35 Billion
